# Provenance & Traceability Checklist: ArtCraft Local Authoring

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the provenance and traceability mechanism — sidecar JSON schema, digest verification, commit trailers, Tier A human review block, CI enforcement, C2PA/SLSA alignment, and the split enforcement model that keeps `npm run ci` offline-safe.

**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) — FR-007, FR-008, FR-013, Constitution Principle IV

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `__SPECKIT_COMMAND_CHECKLIST__` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Sidecar Naming & Placement

- [x] CHK001 — Is the sidecar naming convention explicitly specified as **extension-swap** (master path with extension replaced by `.json`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 — Is the requirement that the sidecar stem matches the master stem exactly explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 — Is the sidecar placement explicitly restricted to `media-src/` (never in `assets/` or `src/`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
  - **Resolved (this review, 2026-10-17)**: Q2 decided — asset-adjacent, outside the publishable tree; raízes permitidas `media-src/` e `marketing/`; verificador cobre todas as raízes. Spec updated in FR-008.
- [x] CHK004 — Is the consequence of a `.json` file in `src/data/` (would be published by `copyPublishableFiles`) explicitly documented as a placement invariant? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 — Is the sidecar explicitly characterized as **one per master, format-agnostic** (regardless of svg/png/jpg)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Sidecar Schema Completeness

- [x] CHK006 — Is `schemaVersion` (string, required) explicitly specified in the schema? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK007 — Is `subject.name` (master basename, required) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 — Is `subject.digest.sha256` (64-hex-lowercase, required) explicitly specified with its format constraint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 — Is `provenance.tool` (string, required) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 — Is `provenance.toolVersion` (string, required) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 — Is `provenance.timestamp` (ISO-8601 UTC, required) explicitly specified with its format constraint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK012 — Is `provenance.author` (string, required) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 — Is `inputs` explicitly specified as an optional array of `{ uri, digest: { sha256 } }`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK014 — Is the `review` block explicitly specified as optional in schema but required (with `decision: approve`) for master-integration commits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Review Block (Tier A) Requirements

- [x] CHK015 — Are all required fields within the `review` block explicitly enumerated: `reviewer`, `reviewedAt`, `oversight`, `notes`, `decision`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK016 — Is the `oversight` enum explicitly specified: `human_authored`, `human_assisted`, `human_reviewed` (project-defined for human-authored masters; C2PA's `fully_autonomous`/`prompt_guided`/`human_validated` apply only to AI-generated content and are deliberately not reused)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK017 — Is the `decision` enum explicitly specified: `approve`, `reject`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK018 — Is `measuredSSIM` explicitly specified as optional within the review block? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK019 — Is the `oversight` vocabulary explicitly characterized as **project-defined for human-authored masters** (`human_authored`/`human_assisted`/`human_reviewed`), and is it stated that C2PA 2.4 §18.28 `humanOversightLevel` values (`fully_autonomous`/`prompt_guided`/`human_validated`) apply only to AI-generated content and are deliberately NOT reused? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK020 — Is it explicitly stated that C2PA defines `humanOversightLevel` **only for AI-generated content** and that no SLSA/in-toto ceremony is introduced? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Digest Verification (Build-Time)

- [x] CHK021 — Is the digest verification explicitly specified as **per master**, running before encoding? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 — Is the behavior on digest mismatch explicitly specified as **fail-fast** (throw)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 — Is the behavior when sidecar is **absent** explicitly specified as **no-op** (build continues)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK024 — Is the SHA-256 recomputation requirement explicitly specified (recompute from master bytes and compare to `subject.digest.sha256`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK025 — Is the `subject.name` staleness check explicitly specified (must match master basename, stale → throw)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK026 — Is the strict schema validation explicitly specified (reject unknown fields)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Sidecar Validation (Fail-Fast Rules)

- [x] CHK027 — Is invalid JSON explicitly specified as a throw condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK028 — Are required-fields-present-with-correct-types explicitly specified as a validation rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK029 — Is the 64-lowercase-hex format constraint for `sha256` explicitly specified as a validation rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK030 — Is ISO-8601 UTC timestamp parsing explicitly specified as a validation rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK031 — Is the `isSafeLocalReference` rule explicitly required for each `inputs[].uri` when present? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Commit Trailers (CI Enforcement)

- [x] CHK032 — Is the primary traceability mechanism explicitly specified as commit trailers (e.g., `Authored-With: vectorcraft-cli 0.12.0`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK033 — Is the Tier A review traceability explicitly specified as a `Reviewed-By: <name>` commit trailer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK034 — Is the enforcement placement explicitly restricted to a **new step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`** (never in `npm run ci`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK035 — Is the `fetch-depth: 0` requirement explicitly specified for the CI step (vs. the workflow's current depth-1 checkout)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK036 — Is the enforcement interval explicitly specified as **forward-only** (commits touching `media-src/` from this feature's merge onward)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK037 — Is the grandfathering of pre-existing commits (squash commits without trailers) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK038 — Is the fail-closed behavior explicitly specified for the CI step (missing any of: sidecar with review, `Authored-With`, `Reviewed-By` → fail)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Split Enforcement Model

- [x] CHK039 — Is the split enforcement model explicitly documented: (1) sidecar digest verified in build when present (fail-fast), (2) commit trailers verified only in CI (forward-only, never in `npm run ci`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK040 — Is the rationale for not enforcing trailers in `npm run ci` explicitly stated (preserves offline/tarball/shallow-clone execution)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK041 — Is the effective-obligatory nature of the sidecar for commits touching `media-src/` (but optional for isolated builds) explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## C2PA / SLSA Alignment

- [x] CHK042 — Is the alignment level explicitly characterized as **SLSA Build L1-analogous** (documented process, not full SLSA)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK043 — Is it explicitly stated that SLSA does not cover local authoring steps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK044 — Is the C2PA 2.4 §18.28 `c2pa.ai-disclosure` / `humanOversightLevel` reference accurately described as applying only to AI-generated content? [Accuracy, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK045 — Is it explicitly stated that no C2PA assertion or in-toto ceremony is introduced for these human-authored masters? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Consistency & Coverage

- [x] CHK046 — Are the sidecar schema fields consistent between the spec (FR-008), the data-model, and the JSON Schema contract? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK047 — Is the `review` block validation (when present) consistently specified across all sections: types, enums, ISO-8601 format? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK048 — Are there provenance edge cases (e.g., master replaced without sidecar update, sidecar for non-existent master) explicitly addressed? [Coverage, Gap]
  - **Resolved (2026-10-17, batch 8)**: "master replaced without sidecar update" → digest mismatch → throw (already covered). "sidecar for non-existent master" (orphan) → **fail-fast** (`orphan-sidecar`), now explicit in FR-008/FR-013, the CI step, `data-model.md` (validation rules + state transitions) and `sidecar.schema.json`. Bidirectional referential integrity, symmetric with `findUnreferencedAssets === []`.
- [x] CHK049 — Is the prohibition of provenance fields in the manifest (schema v1 frozen) explicitly stated and consistent across all sections? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
